The '''Ragnar system''' was located in the [[Merel sector/Legends|Merel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the remote astronomical object [[Ragnar VIII]].<ref name="Journal15">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref> The home offices of the [[Ragnar Syndicate]], a chapter house of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], were located on Ragnar VIII, leading to the celestial body being considered the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the house.<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ragnar [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', a [[1993]] sourcebook written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square Q-18.<ref name="TEA" />
